FAQ

Questions brands ask us.

Where are you based, and which areas do you serve?

Our HQ is in Kuala Lumpur, with teams in Penang and Johor. We work with brands across Malaysia.

What services does Light Wave Creators offer?

Five divisions under one team — Studio (video, photography, AR/VR), AI (WhatsApp & social media AI agents), Academy (HRDF-claimable training), Media (personal branding & marketing) and TikTok MCN (TikTok Shop, creators & KOL).

How long does a commercial or brand film take?

Most brand films and commercials take about 2–4 weeks from briefing to final delivery, depending on the scope. Short-form social videos can be turned around faster. Tell us your deadline and we'll plan backwards from it.

Is your training HRDF-claimable?

Yes. Our training programmes are HRDF-claimable for eligible employers. Share your company details with us and we'll guide you through the claim process.

What is included in TikTok Shop management?

Account setup (TikTok Business, Ads & Seller Center), monthly shop management (campaigns, customer service, ads, affiliate setup and monthly reports) and content (affiliate creators, LIVE hosts, AI video and video production). Plans are customised.

Which platforms and languages does your AI agent support?

WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and your website — replying 24/7 in English, Bahasa Melayu and Chinese.

How do we start working together?

WhatsApp us at 017-773 2100 or send the form below — we reply personally, usually within the hour.
